subject: english
stem: A report is due Friday. Which plan leaves time to check it?
options: revise before doing any research and never draft
research Tuesday, draft Wednesday, revise Thursday
start Friday one minute before class

optionRationales.reason: revise before doing any research and never draft：順序錯。
research Tuesday, draft Wednesday, revise Thursday：逐步且截止前 revision。
start Friday one minute before class：無核對。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「課堂任務的目標、截止與錯誤回饋分別決定預習內容、練習重點與複習證據」可推出 research Tuesday, draft Wednesday, revise Thursday；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 research Tuesday, draft Wednesday, revise Thursday 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
